ENPTES
R-01 · Reflections 04 of 06

A vertical reflective form descends into a compressed base, where curvature intensifies distortion. Its surface stretches and bends the surrounding field into elongated bands. The patterned ground shifts beneath it, destabilizing depth and sustaining tension between structure, surface and perception.
